purpose: 25k-step PPO-vs-SAC verification pilots for the algorithm switch (D-60): 1-D pair (15.07.2026) + 2-D steer+throttle pair (15.07.2026, cablea-2D goal)
config_delta: algorithm + sac block + model_path only; seed 2024, complex_b, enforcement, DR on for both

sac_2d_tuned.recipe: SAC-canonical deltas vs the paired arm: batch 256 (was 64), constant LR (was linear), learning_starts 5000 (was 1000), gradient_steps 2 (UTD 2)

reading: Both learn healthily from pixels; SAC overtakes PPO ~15k and ends +23% ep_rew_mean at the 25k budget with slightly lower cage intervention. 25k is far from the 1-D convergence regime (PPO peaks ~823 at ~297k) - a pilot sanity check, not an algorithm verdict.
reading_2d: 2-D family (0.25 cap, random_start_s, 2048-step episodes; scales NOT comparable to the 1-D column): PPO 113 vs SAC 90 at 25k, but the shapes differ - PPO flattens at the end (114 peak @ ~24.5k) while SAC is still accelerating (7@5k -> 19@12k -> 67@20k -> 90@25k, steepest end-slope of the 4 curves) with the longest episodes (ep_len 198 vs 154; slower but more survivable driving). At 25k neither 2-D arm is near a "good point" (the 2-D PPO 1M baseline peaked 654 @ 510k under the 0.5 cap); whether SAC overtakes needs a longer run - its off-policy warmup (1k random steps + auto-temperature) delays takeoff by design.
reading_2d_tuned: Fifth curve (not part of the like-for-like pair): with only ~20k learning steps (5k warmup) the tuned recipe reaches 107.4 - passes the untuned SAC (90) around ~16k and nearly catches PPO (113) at cutoff with the steepest late slope (31@15k -> 76@20k -> 107@25k). ep_len 131 vs untuned 198: it drives faster (PPO-like profile), easing the slow-but-alive concern, at the cost of a higher (still small) emergency rate (0.011 vs 0.0002). The PPO-inherited values were indeed handicapping SAC; the 1M run should use train_sac_camera_2d_tuned.yaml.
